name: Cyclone
description: Severe tropical storm with destructive winds and rain.

name: High Waves
description: Abnormal swell and dangerous wave surges along shorelines.

name: Tsunami
description: Series of ocean waves caused by underwater seismic activity.

name: Flood
description: Coastal inundation or sea overflow into habited land.

name: Storm Surge
description: Rising sea levels due to low-pressure coastal storm systems.

name: Coastal Erosion
description: Rapid shore washouts and structural damage to coastal cliffs.

name: Oil Spill
description: Hazardous liquid petroleum released into marine ecosystems.

name: Boat Accident
description: Fishing trawler capsizing or vessel distress at sea.

name: Ship Collision
description: Collision involving cargo, tanker, or passenger vessels.

name: Sea Pollution
description: Toxic chemical runoff or mass industrial discharge.

name: Floating Debris
description: Heavy marine debris posing hazards to small sea crafts.

name: Dead Marine Animals
description: Mass stranding of cetaceans or bio-hazard marine carcasses.

name: Illegal Fishing
description: Unauthorized poaching inside protected marine zones.

name: Missing Fisherman
description: Uncontactable fishing vessels or crew lost beyond EEZ.

name: Unknown Hazard
description: Unidentified coastal hazard requiring immediate AI scan.
